title: Tax Refund for Household
scenario: An email says your household tax refund is ready after identity confirmation.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.C: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Tax Refund for Household: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Tax refunds should be verified through official tax accounts.
